entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Manuel González-Hontoria y Fernández-Ladreda was a Spanish politician and diplomat who served two times as Minister of Estate during the reign of Alfonso XIII. He was also the son of the artillery inventor/engineer and military man José González Hontoria.
